1354inline void* import_function(void *module, const char* proc_name)
1355{
1356#ifdef __linux__
1357 return dlsym(module, proc_name);
1358#else
1359 return reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(static_cast<HMODULE>(module), proc_name));
1360#endif
1361}
1362
1363inline DynamicLoader::DynamicLoader()
1364{
1365#if defined _WIN32 || defined _WIN64
1366 size_t sz = 0;
1367 if (_wgetenv_s(&sz, NULL, 0, L"IDS_PEAK_GENERIC_SDK_PATH") == 0
1368 && sz > 0)
1369 {
1370 std::vector<wchar_t> env_ids_peak(sz);
1371 if (_wgetenv_s(&sz, env_ids_peak.data(), sz, L"IDS_PEAK_GENERIC_SDK_PATH") == 0)
1372 {
1373 if (_wgetenv_s(&sz, NULL, 0, L"PATH") == 0
1374 && sz > 0)
1375 {
1376 std::vector<wchar_t> env_path(sz);
1377 if (_wgetenv_s(&sz, env_path.data(), sz, L"PATH") == 0)
1378 {
1379 std::wstring ids_peak_path(env_ids_peak.data());
1380#ifdef _WIN64
1381 ids_peak_path.append(L"\\api\\lib\\x86_64");
1382#else
1383 ids_peak_path.append(L"\\api\\lib\\x86_32");
1384#endif
1385 AddDllDirectory(ids_peak_path.c_str());
1386 }
1387 }
1388 }
1389 }
1390
1391 loadLib("ids_peak.dll");
1392#else
1393 loadLib("libids_peak.so");
1394#endif
1395}
1396
1397inline DynamicLoader::~DynamicLoader()
1398{
1399 if(m_handle != nullptr)
1400 {
1401 unload();
1402 }
1403}
1404
1405inline bool DynamicLoader::isLoaded()
1406{
1407 auto&& inst = instance();
1408 return inst.m_handle != nullptr;
1409}
1410
1411inline void DynamicLoader::unload()
1412{
1413 setPointers(false);
1414
1415 if (m_handle != nullptr)
1416 {
1417#ifdef __linux__
1418 dlclose(m_handle);
1419#else
1420 FreeLibrary(static_cast<HMODULE>(m_handle));
1421#endif
1422 }
1423 m_handle = nullptr;
1424}
1425
1426
1427inline bool DynamicLoader::loadLib(const char* file)
1428{
1429 bool ret = false;
1430
1431 if (file)
1432 {
1433#ifdef __linux__
1434 m_handle = dlopen(file, RTLD_NOW);
1435#else
1436 m_handle = LoadLibraryExA(file, nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DEFAULT_DIRS);
1437#endif
1438 if (m_handle != nullptr)
1439 {
1440 try {
1441 setPointers(true);
1442 ret = true;
1443 } catch (const std::exception&) {
1444 unload();
1445 throw;
1446 }
1447 }
1448 else
1449 {
1450 throw LoadLibraryException(std::string("Lib load failed: ") + file);
1451 }
1452 }
1453 else
1454 {
1455 throw LoadLibraryException("Filename empty");
1456 }
1457
1458 return ret;
1459}
